name: Augustine Ozor
headline: Turning responsible AI principles into working controls.
summary: I help organisations govern AI systems: inventories, risk registers, policies and compliance programmes mapped to the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 27001, with evidence an auditor can follow.
about: I work where engineering, audit and the business meet. My background spans enterprise cybersecurity, information science and cloud security, and my job is translating technical risk into clear controls, documentation and remediation actions that all three can agree on.
expertise: AI risk registers and impact assessments
Responsible AI policy and human oversight
EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001 and NIST AI RMF
AI vendor and third-party risk management
ITGCs, control testing and audit evidence
AWS and Azure security, IAM and encryption

experience.detail: AWS and Azure security, IAM/RBAC, vulnerability remediation and CI/CD compliance.
ICT and cyber-awareness training, endpoint security and phishing-prevention workshops.
